title: Graph Representation via Elements of Discrete Morse and Cobordism Theories
summary: Topology is, by its nature and design, suited to structure that is nonlinear, multiscale, and nonstationary - however, within machine learning, its use remains largely confined to topological data analysis. We advocate that tools from low-dimensional topology which have remained almost exclusively contained within the domain of pure mathematics (such as Morse theory) offer a strong, complementary, and yet virtually unexplored perspective on the hidden structure of data-generating processes and learning tasks built upon them.
